source: Own measurement on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: draw 2, 12 episodes, 2 per unit) with this build's grader (the controller's own time as the budget, the numerics pin and its fingerprint, the reference without a wall-clock limit): the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) scored credit 1.0 on each of the 12 episodes in each of its three wire runs at the selection (2026-11-21, tests/hidden/episode_selection.json: 36 runs, mean 1.0), and mean_episode_credit 1.0 through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505) in the `ale validate` of this tree that the pull request names. Draw 1's measurements (2026-11-19 to 11-21, five validates at 1.0) were of the earlier set and files; tests/NOTICE.md says what changed.
note: Measured, not drawn. The set holds only episodes on which the reference scored credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire when it was selected (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json, draw 2). full_at 0.98: one lane's facing lost (0.2 / 3 of one episode's credit, 0.0056 of the metric) still gives the reference reward 1.0.
